I am 62 and farming alone, so this year I will keep the plan steady and manageable. I have 15 mu and well irrigation, so I will use the land in the way I trust most: I will keep 5 mu in stevia because it brings cash, but I will not expand it because it takes more labor and closer field care. On the other 10 mu, I will do my usual grain ground with winter wheat first and then summer maize after wheat harvest, because that fits Quzhou County conditions and spreads my risk. I will use improved or hybrid seed where it matters, give moderate fertilizer instead of pushing too hard, irrigate when the crop really needs it, and keep pesticide use limited to what I think is necessary. I care more about a stable harvest that I can manage by myself than chasing the very highest yield.
